bookings_dates_check.name: bookings_dates_check
bookings_dates_check.value: "vector"."bookings"."etd" is null or "vector"."bookings"."eta" is null or "vector"."bookings"."etd" <= "vector"."bookings"."eta"

bookings_cutoffs_check.name: bookings_cutoffs_check
bookings_cutoffs_check.value: "vector"."bookings"."docs_cutoff" is null or "vector"."bookings"."cargo_cutoff" is null or "vector"."bookings"."docs_cutoff" <= "vector"."bookings"."cargo_cutoff" + interval '7 days'

compliance_by_check.name: compliance_by_check
compliance_by_check.value: "vector"."compliance_checks"."state" = 'pending' or ("vector"."compliance_checks"."by_name" is not null and "vector"."compliance_checks"."at" is not null)

costs_some_check.name: costs_some_check
costs_some_check.value: "vector"."cost_lines"."estimated" is not null or "vector"."cost_lines"."quoted" is not null or "vector"."cost_lines"."invoiced" is not null

costs_invoice_check.name: costs_invoice_check
costs_invoice_check.value: ("vector"."cost_lines"."invoiced" is null) = ("vector"."cost_lines"."invoice_date" is null) and ("vector"."cost_lines"."invoiced" is null or btrim(coalesce("vector"."cost_lines"."invoice_number", '')) <> '')

customs_exit_check.name: customs_exit_check
customs_exit_check.value: "vector"."customs_declarations"."exit_on" is null or ("vector"."customs_declarations"."mrn" is not null and ("vector"."customs_declarations"."lodged_on" is null or "vector"."customs_declarations"."lodged_on" <= "vector"."customs_declarations"."exit_on"))

incidents_claimed_check.name: incidents_claimed_check
incidents_claimed_check.value: "vector"."incidents"."state" not in ('claimed', 'settled', 'rejected') or ("vector"."incidents"."claimed_amount" is not null and "vector"."incidents"."claim_sent_on" is not null)

loads_container_check.name: loads_container_check
loads_container_check.value: "vector"."loads"."type" not in ('c20', 'c40', 'c40hc', 'open_top', 'flat_rack') or "vector"."loads"."identifier" is null or "vector"."loads"."identifier" ~ '^[A-Z]{4}[0-9]{7}$'

milestones_dates_check.name: milestones_dates_check
milestones_dates_check.value: "vector"."milestones"."planned_on" is not null or "vector"."milestones"."actual_on" is not null

lines_dg_check.name: lines_dg_check
lines_dg_check.value: ("vector"."package_lines"."un_number" is null and "vector"."package_lines"."dg_class" is null and "vector"."package_lines"."dg_packing_group" is null) or ("vector"."package_lines"."un_number" ~ '^UN[0-9]{4}$' and "vector"."package_lines"."dg_class" ~ '^[1-9](\.[1-6])?$' and ("vector"."package_lines"."dg_packing_group" is null or "vector"."package_lines"."dg_packing_group" in ('I', 'II', 'III')))

packages_dims_check.name: packages_dims_check
packages_dims_check.value: "vector"."packages"."length_cm" between 1 and 5000 and "vector"."packages"."width_cm" between 1 and 2000 and "vector"."packages"."height_cm" between 1 and 2000

requests_imputation_check.name: requests_imputation_check
requests_imputation_check.value: "vector"."shipment_requests"."project_code" is not null or "vector"."shipment_requests"."cost_code" is not null

shipments_ports_check.name: shipments_ports_check
shipments_ports_check.value: ("vector"."shipments"."port_of_loading" is null or "vector"."shipments"."port_of_loading" ~ '^[A-Z]{2}[A-Z0-9]{3}$') and ("vector"."shipments"."port_of_discharge" is null or "vector"."shipments"."port_of_discharge" ~ '^[A-Z]{2}[A-Z0-9]{3}$')

shipments_lc_dates_check.name: shipments_lc_dates_check
shipments_lc_dates_check.value: "vector"."shipments"."lc_latest_shipment" is null or "vector"."shipments"."lc_expiry" is null or "vector"."shipments"."lc_latest_shipment" <= "vector"."shipments"."lc_expiry"

shipments_dates_check.name: shipments_dates_check
shipments_dates_check.value: ("vector"."shipments"."etd" is null or "vector"."shipments"."eta" is null or "vector"."shipments"."etd" <= "vector"."shipments"."eta") and ("vector"."shipments"."atd" is null or "vector"."shipments"."ata" is null or "vector"."shipments"."atd" <= "vector"."shipments"."ata") and ("vector"."shipments"."ata" is null or "vector"."shipments"."delivered_on" is null or "vector"."shipments"."ata" <= "vector"."shipments"."delivered_on")

shipments_previous_state_check.name: shipments_previous_state_check
shipments_previous_state_check.value: ("vector"."shipments"."state" = 'on_hold') = ("vector"."shipments"."previous_state" is not null) and ("vector"."shipments"."previous_state" is null or "vector"."shipments"."previous_state" in ('draft', 'planned', 'booked', 'picked_up', 'in_transit', 'arrived', 'delivered', 'closed', 'cancelled', 'on_hold'))

shipments_pod_check.name: shipments_pod_check
shipments_pod_check.value: "vector"."shipments"."state" not in ('delivered', 'closed') or ("vector"."shipments"."delivered_on" is not null and btrim(coalesce("vector"."shipments"."pod_codex_ref", '')) <> '')

sites_coords_check.name: sites_coords_check
sites_coords_check.value: ("vector"."sites"."latitude" is null) = ("vector"."sites"."longitude" is null) and ("vector"."sites"."latitude" is null or ("vector"."sites"."latitude" between -90 and 90 and "vector"."sites"."longitude" between -180 and 180))
